title: LiveOpenreSlotBindRequest
description: live.openre-slot-bind-request@1: the body of POST /internal/openre/slots on OpenVibe.Live (capability live.openre.slot.bind). OpenRestream asks Live for a slot on the person's channel bound to one OpenRestream stream (openre_stream_id, std_…); subject is the person who owns that stream. title names the slot on the person's dashboard.
